notes:
- A French-first license agreement explains the one-year, one-device license and 30-day refund, including after activation. Existing perpetual entitlements are preserved. You will be asked to accept the agreement once.
- What's new is now available from Settings and appears once after updating.
- Check for updates in Settings. Update prompts include release notes; downloads are verified before being saved and never install automatically.
- Open-source notices and local-processing/privacy details are available in Settings.
- More consistent saving of unfinished work and preferences, with consolidated native-tool discovery.
- Improved application security and packaging checks for native tools, licenses and the bundled speech model.
